why_chosen: Assigned; job seeker considering store/outlet management role

identity.summary: SGX-listed (2011) supermarket group, established 1985, Sheng Siong Group Ltd (SGX: OV8).
identity.how_openserp_helped: Search surfaced the company's own IR page and SGX filings.
identity.what_was_missing: Exact legal registration details not checked.

business_and_headcount.summary: 90 stores in Singapore plus 6 in Kunming, China (Jul 2026); new S$520M HQ/distribution centre to support 120+ stores. Employee count 4,174 reported only in a search snippet from companies.sg (unverified in full).
business_and_headcount.what_was_missing: Headcount not confirmed from the annual report itself.

financial_performance.summary: FY2025 revenue S$1.57B (+9.9%), net profit S$149.2M (+8.5%), cash S$435.5M, dividends 7.0c. 1H FY2026 revenue S$855.4M (+11.9%), net profit S$81.0M (+11.9%).
financial_performance.how_openserp_helped: Primary company releases found and read fully.
financial_performance.what_was_missing: Independent analyst view only via snippets.

layoffs_restructuring.summary: No Sheng Siong layoffs found; the search returned only generic Singapore retrenchment pages. Absence of evidence, not proof. Staff numbers rose in FY2025 per results release.
layoffs_restructuring.what_was_missing: Layoff tracker page not extracted; no way to confirm none.

culture_and_sentiment.summary: Glassdoor snippets: 49% recommend, work-life balance 2.6/5, culture 3.3, career 3.2 (another regional page: 52%, WLB 2.8). Jobstreet (13 reviews): WLB 4.1, management 4.2; cashier roles described as physically demanding, long hours; some manager communication issues. One Indeed review snippet calls it very stressful. Small samples, conflicting.
culture_and_sentiment.how_openserp_helped: Search snippets gave Glassdoor ratings even though Glassdoor extraction failed; Jobstreet extracted.
culture_and_sentiment.what_was_missing: Reddit search returned unrelated junk; no forum discussion; no management-level-specific sentiment.

pay_and_benefits.summary: Indeed: retail cashier about S$1,609/month (2 reports), process worker S$1,714 (4). Glassdoor snippet: manager average 'S$7,000 per year or S$3/hour' (5 submissions) which is implausible and unusable. No store manager salary or benefits list found.
pay_and_benefits.what_was_missing: Store manager / assistant manager pay and benefits not found.

interview_and_hiring.summary: Company career page lists Management Trainee roles open to degree/diploma/ITE holders incl. fresh graduates; Glassdoor has 19-20 interview reviews but only snippet generic text read. No store-manager-specific hiring process found.
interview_and_hiring.how_openserp_helped: Search found career pages and interview-review pages.
interview_and_hiring.what_was_missing: Job page extract was mostly a country-code dropdown; interview details not read.

red_flags_and_scams.summary: No scams or regulatory trouble found in searches. Only legal news was a shoplifter jailed after Sheng Siong facial-recognition match (not a company issue).

recent_news.summary: Jul 2026 groundbreaking of S$520M integrated HQ and distribution centre (DPM attended); 1H FY2026 profit +11.9%; 3 more stores expected Q3 2026.
recent_news.how_openserp_helped: Good recency and dates in search results.

blocked_or_unreadable_sites: corporate.shengsiong.com.sg job page returned mostly form dropdown junk
misleading_or_wrong_results: Reddit query returned unrelated Reddit/Halloween/NY Post pages
Layoff query returned generic Singapore retrenchment news
Glassdoor manager salary snippet (S$7,000/yr, S$3/hr) is implausible

verdict.reasoning: Excellent for company facts and finance; weak for management-level pay, culture depth and interview detail, where review sites block extraction or return thin samples. Some searches take 25-30s.
what_else_a_job_seeker_would_need: Offer letter terms on shifts and hours
